fr.recommendations:
• Install a reflective address marker at the driveway entrance to help responders confirm the correct property from the road.
• Mark the single driveway entrance clearly so responding units can locate it quickly under low-light or smoky conditions.
• Keep the access drive clear of parked vehicles, equipment, and debris so responding units can reach both the main residence and the detached structure without obstruction.
• Trim any shrubs or tree branches along the access drive that hang low enough to slow or block emergency vehicles.
• Cut back vegetation growing close to the main residence and detached structure so responders can move around both buildings without obstruction.
• Keep a clear path between the main residence and the detached structure so crews can move between them quickly.
• Post the address or a simple property map at the entrance showing the location of the detached structure, which may not be visible from the road.
• Designate and keep clear a flat area near the access drive where a responding unit can turn around or stage without blocking the drive.
• Keep the perimeter fencing gate nearest the detached structure unlocked or secured with a breakaway lock so responders can reach it without delay.
• Keep the patio area and walkway clear of furniture and portable items that could block movement around the residence during an emergency.

wildfire.recommendations:
• Thin the tree cluster to create more open space between individual trees and reduce the amount of connected vegetation near the structure.
• Trim or remove shrubs and plants that are growing directly against or touching the structure.
• Separate the scattered shrubs from nearby trees so vegetation is not connected from the ground up into the tree canopy.
• Keep low-hanging branches on scattered trees trimmed up from the ground to reduce the path fire can take from ground vegetation into the trees.
• Remove any dead or dry plant material from within the irrigated landscape beds closest to the structure.
• Keep the areas under and around scattered trees clear of fallen leaves, dead branches, and dry debris.
• Maintain the open green space by keeping grass mowed short, especially where it connects to shrubs or trees near the structure.
• Keep all access routes clear of overhanging branches and encroaching vegetation so vehicles can pass through without obstruction.
